Hello team,

Quick note on the Starling file: please keep the handoff tight and make sure the traveler support steps are clear before departure. We want the passengers to feel covered, and the pet should get the same calm, careful treatment from our trained crew throughout the process.

The onboard handler for the Starling is Bela Thorn.

If Yara Bianchi and Andre Larsen need a refresher, point them to the standard travel checklist and confirm the carrier, documents, and comfort plan are all set. That keeps things smooth at the counter and avoids last-minute scrambling. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping Aurelia Skyways practical, kind, and easy to work with.
